<includeonly><infobox type="Stances">
    <title source="title"/>
    <image source="image"><caption source="imagecaption"/></image>

    <data source="description"><label>Description</label></data>
    <data source="switch_message"><label>Switch Message</label></data>

    <group collapse="open">
        <header>Combat Modifiers</header>
        <data source="damage_mod"><label>Physical Damage</label><format>{{#ifexpr: {{{damage_mod|1}}} = 1 | — |{{#ifexpr: {{{damage_mod|1}}} > 1 |+}}{{#expr: ({{{damage_mod|1}}} - 1) * 100 round 0}}%}}</format></data>
        <data source="spell_damage_mod"><label>Spell Damage</label><format>{{#ifexpr: {{{spell_damage_mod|1}}} = 1 | — |{{#ifexpr: {{{spell_damage_mod|1}}} > 1 |+}}{{#expr: ({{{spell_damage_mod|1}}} - 1) * 100 round 0}}%}}</format></data>
        <data source="damage_taken_mod"><label>Damage Taken</label><format>{{#ifexpr: {{{damage_taken_mod|1}}} = 1 | — |{{#ifexpr: {{{damage_taken_mod|1}}} > 1 |+}}{{#expr: ({{{damage_taken_mod|1}}} - 1) * 100 round 0}}%}}</format></data>
        <data source="max_hp_mod"><label>Max HP</label><format>{{#ifexpr: {{{max_hp_mod|1}}} = 1 | — |{{#ifexpr: {{{max_hp_mod|1}}} > 1 |+}}{{#expr: ({{{max_hp_mod|1}}} - 1) * 100 round 0}}%}}</format></data>
        <data source="proc_rate_mod"><label>Proc Rate</label><format>{{#ifexpr: {{{proc_rate_mod|1}}} = 1 | — |{{#ifexpr: {{{proc_rate_mod|1}}} > 1 |+}}{{#expr: ({{{proc_rate_mod|1}}} - 1) * 100 round 0}}%}}</format></data>
        <data source="aggro_gen_mod"><label>Aggro Generation</label><format>{{#ifexpr: {{{aggro_gen_mod|1}}} = 1 | — |{{#ifexpr: {{{aggro_gen_mod|1}}} > 1 |+}}{{#expr: ({{{aggro_gen_mod|1}}} - 1) * 100 round 0}}%}}</format></data>
    </group>

    <group collapse="open">
        <header>Special Effects</header>
        <data source="self_damage_per_attack"><label>Self Damage per Attack</label><format>{{{self_damage_per_attack|}}}% max HP</format></data>
        <data source="self_damage_per_cast"><label>Self Damage per Cast</label><format>{{{self_damage_per_cast|}}}</format></data>
        <data source="lifesteal_amount"><label>Lifesteal</label><format>{{{lifesteal_amount|}}}%</format></data>
        <data source="resonance_amount"><label>Resonance</label><format>{{#ifexpr: {{{resonance_amount|1}}} = 1 | — |{{#ifexpr: {{{resonance_amount|1}}} > 1 |+}}{{#expr: ({{{resonance_amount|1}}} - 1) * 100 round 0}}%}}</format></data>
        <data source="stop_regen"><label>Stops Regeneration</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{{stop_regen|}}}|1|Yes}}</format></data>
    </group>

    <group collapse="open">
        <header>Acquisition</header>
        <data source="activated_by"><label>Activated by</label></data>
    </group>
</infobox>{{#ifeq: {{NAMESPACENUMBER}} | 0 | [[Category:Stances]]}}</includeonly><noinclude>
== Template:Stance ==

Infobox template for displaying combat stance information. Stances are toggleable
combat modes that modify a character's stats. They are activated by specific skills.

Modifier values are stored as raw multipliers where 1.0 means no change (100%).
The template converts these to human-readable percentages: a value of 1.4 displays
as "+40%", 0.66 as "-34%", and 2.0 as "+100%". Fields at the 1.0 baseline show
an em dash (—) to indicate no change.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Type !! Description
|-
| '''title''' || Yes || string || Stance name (displayed as infobox title)
|-
| '''image''' || Yes || wikitext || Stance icon: <code><nowiki>[[File:Stance Name.png|thumb]]</nowiki></code>
|-
| '''imagecaption''' || No || string || Caption for the image
|-
| '''description''' || No || string || Stance description / flavor text
|-
| '''switch_message''' || No || string || Message shown when the stance is activated
|-
! colspan="4" | Combat Modifiers ''(multipliers: 1.0 = no change, >1.0 = increase, <1.0 = decrease)''
|-
| '''damage_mod''' || No || float || Physical damage multiplier. 1.4 → "+40%"
|-
| '''spell_damage_mod''' || No || float || Spell damage multiplier. 1.0 → "—"
|-
| '''damage_taken_mod''' || No || float || Incoming damage multiplier. 0.8 → "-20%"
|-
| '''max_hp_mod''' || No || float || Maximum HP multiplier
|-
| '''proc_rate_mod''' || No || float || Proc rate multiplier
|-
| '''aggro_gen_mod''' || No || float || Aggro generation multiplier. 10.0 → "+900%"
|-
! colspan="4" | Special Effects
|-
| '''self_damage_per_attack''' || No || float || % of max HP lost per melee attack. 4.0 → "4% max HP"
|-
| '''self_damage_per_cast''' || No || float || HP lost per spell cast
|-
| '''lifesteal_amount''' || No || float || Lifesteal percentage per hit
|-
| '''resonance_amount''' || No || float || Resonance multiplier (same format as combat modifiers)
|-
| '''stop_regen''' || No || integer || Disables HP/mana regeneration. 1 → "Yes", 0 or blank → hidden
|-
! colspan="4" | Acquisition
|-
| '''activated_by''' || No || wikitext || Skills that activate this stance (e.g. <code><nowiki>{{AbilityLink|Stance: Aggressive}}</nowiki></code>)
|}

=== Examples ===

==== Normal Stance (all defaults) ====

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Stance
|title=Normal
|image=[[File:Stance: Normal.png|thumb]]
|description=A normal combat stance with no penalties or bonuses.
|switch_message=shifts into a normal combat stance
|max_hp_mod=1.0
|damage_mod=1.0
|damage_taken_mod=1.0
|proc_rate_mod=1.0
|aggro_gen_mod=1.0
|spell_damage_mod=1.0
|resonance_amount=1.0
|activated_by=
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Stance
|title=Normal
|image=[[File:Stance: Normal.png|thumb]]
|description=A normal combat stance with no penalties or bonuses.

|resonance_amount=1.0

|description=Gain a 40% increase to physical damage dealt, but take 40% more incoming damage from all sources. Your focus on offense stops all natural health regeneration.
|switch_message=shifts into an aggressive combat stance
|max_hp_mod=1.0
|damage_mod=1.4
|damage_taken_mod=1.4
|proc_rate_mod=1.0
|aggro_gen_mod=1.0
|spell_damage_mod=1.0
|resonance_amount=1.0
|stop_regen=1
|activated_by={{AbilityLink|Stance: Aggressive}}
}}
</pre>

=== Formatting Details ===

==== Multiplier Conversion ====

Combat modifier values are raw multipliers from the game data where 1.0 = no change:

{| class="wikitable"
! Raw Value !! Displayed As !! Meaning
|-
| 1.0 || — || No change from baseline
|-
| 1.4 || +40% || 40% increase
|-
| 0.66 || -34% || 34% decrease
|-
| 2.0 || +100% || Doubled
|-
| 10.0 || +900% || 10x multiplier
|}

Percentages are rounded to the nearest integer.

==== Special Effects ====

* '''Self Damage per Attack''': Displayed as "X% max HP" (value is already in percentage points)
* '''Self Damage per Cast''': Displayed as raw value (flat HP cost)
* '''Lifesteal''': Displayed as "X%"
* '''Resonance''': Multiplier, same conversion as combat modifiers
* '''Stops Regeneration''': Shows "Yes" when value is 1, hidden when 0 or blank
